    v = _genv[k]; if v ~= nil then return v; end;
    return _G[k];
  end,
  __newindex = function(t, k, v)
    _fenv[k] = v; if _genv[k] ~= nil then _genv[k] = v; end;
  end
});

local _gt = v1420["table"] or table or {};
local _unpack = unpack or _gt.unpack;
local _pcall = pcall;
local _ins = _gt.insert;
local _rem = _gt.remove;
local v1422 = {};
local function v1421(proto_id, parent_upvals, ...)
  local cur_p = v1419[proto_id];
  if not cur_p then return nil end;
  if cur_p.fn then
    local rets = {_pcall(cur_p.fn, ...)}
    if rets[1] then return _unpack(rets, 2, #rets) else error(rets[2]) end
  end
  local code = cur_p[1] or {};
  local k = cur_p[2] or {};
  local psubs = cur_p[3] or {};
  local stack = {};
  local pc = 1;
  local top = 0;
  local upvals = parent_upvals or {};
  local varargs = {...};
  local cstack = {};
  for i = 1, #varargs do stack[i - 1] = varargs[i] end;
  top = #varargs - 1;
  while pc <= #code do
    local inst = code[pc];
    local op = inst[1]; local a = inst[2]; local b = inst[3]; local c = inst[4];
    if op == 0x5D then pc = pc + 1;
    elseif op == 0x3A then stack[a] = stack[b]; pc = pc + 1;
    elseif op == 0x22 then stack[a] = k[b + 1]; pc = pc + 1;
    elseif op == 0xA1 then stack[a] = (b ~= 0); if c ~= 0 then pc = pc + 1 end; pc = pc + 1;
    elseif op == 0x05 then for i = a, b do stack[i] = nil end; pc = pc + 1;
    elseif op == 0xD1 then stack[a] = upvals[b + 1]; pc = pc + 1;
    elseif op == 0x51 then upvals[b + 1] = stack[a]; pc = pc + 1;
    elseif op == 0x7C then stack[a] = v1420[k[b + 1]]; pc = pc + 1;
    elseif op == 0xEC then v1420[k[b + 1]] = stack[a]; pc = pc + 1;
    elseif op == 0xC7 then local t = stack[b]; local key = (c >= 256 and k[c - 255] or stack[c]); stack[a] = t and t[key]; pc = pc + 1;
    elseif op == 0x28 then local t = stack[a]; local key = (b >= 256 and k[b - 255] or stack[b]); local val = (c >= 256 and k[c - 255] or stack[c]); if t then t[key] = val end; pc = pc + 1;
    elseif op == 0x1D then stack[a] = {}; pc = pc + 1;
    elseif op == 0x07 then local t = stack[b]; local key = (c >= 256 and k[c - 255] or stack[c]); stack[a + 1] = t; stack[a] = t and t[key]; pc = pc + 1;
    elseif op == 0x85 then local vb = (b >= 256 and k[b - 255] or stack[b]); local vc = (c >= 256 and k[c - 255] or stack[c]); stack[a] = (vb or 0) + (vc or 0); pc = pc + 1;
    elseif op == 0xEE then local vb = (b >= 256 and k[b - 255] or stack[b]); local vc = (c >= 256 and k[c - 255] or stack[c]); stack[a] = (vb or 0) - (vc or 0); pc = pc + 1;
    elseif op == 0xB9 then local vb = (b >= 256 and k[b - 255] or stack[b]); local vc = (c >= 256 and k[c - 255] or stack[c]); stack[a] = (vb or 0) * (vc or 0); pc = pc + 1;
    elseif op == 0x30 then local vb = (b >= 256 and k[b - 255] or stack[b]); local vc = (c >= 256 and k[c - 255] or stack[c]); local d = vc or 1; if d == 0 then d = 1 end; stack[a] = (vb or 0) / d; pc = pc + 1;
    elseif op == 0x41 then local vb = (b >= 256 and k[b - 255] or stack[b]); local vc = (c >= 256 and k[c - 255] or stack[c]); local d = vc or 1; if d == 0 then d = 1 end; stack[a] = (vb or 0) % d; pc = pc + 1;
    elseif op == 0x34 then local vb = (b >= 256 and k[b - 255] or stack[b]); local vc = (c >= 256 and k[c - 255] or stack[c]); stack[a] = (vb or 0) ^ (vc or 0); pc = pc + 1;
    elseif op == 0x0F then stack[a] = -(stack[b] or 0); pc = pc + 1;
    elseif op == 0xCE then stack[a] = not stack[b]; pc = pc + 1;
    elseif op == 0x18 then stack[a] = #(stack[b] or ""); pc = pc + 1;
    elseif op == 0xE0 then local res = ""; for i = b, c do res = res .. tostring(stack[i] ~= nil and stack[i] or "") end; stack[a] = res; pc = pc + 1;
    elseif op == 0xC8 then pc = pc + b + 1;
    elseif op == 0xE9 then local vb = (b >= 256 and k[b - 255] or stack[b]); local vc = (c >= 256 and k[c - 255] or stack[c]); if (vb == vc) ~= (a ~= 0) then pc = pc + 1 end; pc = pc + 1;
    elseif op == 0xD9 then local vb = (b >= 256 and k[b - 255] or stack[b]); local vc = (c >= 256 and k[c - 255] or stack[c]); if (vb < vc) ~= (a ~= 0) then pc = pc + 1 end; pc = pc + 1;
    elseif op == 0xE3 then local vb = (b >= 256 and k[b - 255] or stack[b]); local vc = (c >= 256 and k[c - 255] or stack[c]); if (vb <= vc) ~= (a ~= 0) then pc = pc + 1 end; pc = pc + 1;
    elseif op == 0x69 then if (not not stack[a]) ~= (c ~= 0) then pc = pc + 1 end; pc = pc + 1;
    elseif op == 0xC2 then if (not not stack[b]) ~= (c ~= 0) then pc = pc + 1 else stack[a] = stack[b] end; pc = pc + 1;
    elseif op == 0x3E then
      local fn = stack[a]; local args = {};
      if b == 0 then for i = a + 1, top do _ins(args, stack[i]) end
      else for i = a + 1, a + b - 1 do _ins(args, stack[i]) end end;
      local vm_meta = v1422[fn] or (type(fn) == "table" and fn._is_vm and fn);
      if vm_meta then
        _ins(cstack, {cur_p = cur_p, code = code, k = k, psubs = psubs, pc = pc + 1, stack = stack, top = top, upvals = upvals, varargs = varargs, dest = a, cnt = c});
        cur_p = v1419[vm_meta.pid];
        code = cur_p[1] or {}; k = cur_p[2] or {}; psubs = cur_p[3] or {};
        upvals = vm_meta.upvals or {}; varargs = args; stack = {};
        for i = 1, #args do stack[i - 1] = args[i] end; top = #args - 1; pc = 1;
      else

        if rets[1] then
          local n_rets = #rets - 1;
          if c == 0 then top = a + n_rets - 1; for i = 1, n_rets do stack[a + i - 1] = rets[i + 1] end;
          elseif c > 1 then for i = 1, c - 1 do stack[a + i - 1] = rets[i + 1] end end;
          pc = pc + 1;
        else error(rets[2]) end;
      end;
    elseif op == 0xDD then
      local fn = stack[a]; local args = {};
      if b == 0 then for i = a + 1, top do _ins(args, stack[i]) end
      else for i = a + 1, a + b - 1 do _ins(args, stack[i]) end end;
      return fn(_unpack(args, 1, #args));
    elseif op == 0x6C then
      local rets = {};
      if b == 0 then for i = a, top do _ins(rets, stack[i]) end
      elseif b > 1 then for i = a, a + b - 2 do _ins(rets, stack[i]) end end;
      if #cstack > 0 then
        local caller = _rem(cstack);
        cur_p = caller.cur_p; code = caller.code; k = caller.k; psubs = caller.psubs;
        pc = caller.pc; stack = caller.stack; top = caller.top; upvals = caller.upvals; varargs = caller.varargs;
        local dest = caller.dest; local cnt = caller.cnt;
        if cnt == 0 then top = dest + #rets - 1; for i = 1, #rets do stack[dest + i - 1] = rets[i] end;
        elseif cnt > 1 then for i = 1, cnt - 1 do stack[dest + i - 1] = rets[i] end end;
      else return _unpack(rets, 1, #rets) end;
    elseif op == 0x7D then
      local step = stack[a + 2]; local idx = stack[a] + step; local limit = stack[a + 1];
      if (step > 0 and idx <= limit) or (step <= 0 and idx >= limit) then
        stack[a] = idx; stack[a + 3] = idx; pc = pc + b + 1;
      else pc = pc + 1 end;
    elseif op == 0xF4 then
      local init = stack[a]; local limit = stack[a + 1]; local step = stack[a + 2];
      stack[a] = init - step; pc = pc + b + 1;
    elseif op == 0x5B then
      local f = stack[a]; local s = stack[a + 1]; local var = stack[a + 2];
      local rets = {_pcall(f, s, var)};
      if rets[1] and rets[2] ~= nil then
        for i = 1, c do stack[a + 2 + i] = rets[1 + i] end;
        stack[a + 2] = rets[2]; pc = pc + 1;
      else pc = pc + 2 end;
    elseif op == 0x78 then
      local t = stack[a]; for i = 1, b do t[(c - 1) * 50 + i] = stack[a + i] end; pc = pc + 1;
    elseif op == 0x9C then
      local target_pid = psubs[b + 1] or (b + 1);
      local cl = function(...) return v1421(target_pid, stack, ...) end;
      v1422[cl] = {pid = target_pid, upvals = stack};
      stack[a] = cl; pc = pc + 1;
    elseif op == 0x9F then
      if b == 0 then for i = 1, #varargs do stack[a + i - 1] = varargs[i] end; top = a + #varargs - 1;
      else for i = 1, b - 1 do stack[a + i - 1] = varargs[i] end end; pc = pc + 1;
    elseif op == 0x35 then
      local chunk = k[b + 1];
      local _loader = loadstring or (getgenv and getgenv().loadstring) or load;
      if _loader then
        local fn, err = _loader(chunk);
        if fn then
          if setfenv then pcall(setfenv, fn, v1420); end;
          local rets = {_pcall(fn, ...)};
          if rets[1] then
            local n_rets = #rets - 1;
            if c == 0 then
              top = a + n_rets - 1;
              for i = 1, n_rets do stack[a + i - 1] = rets[i + 1]; end;
            elseif c > 1 then
              for i = 1, c - 1 do stack[a + i - 1] = rets[i + 1]; end;
            end;
            pc = pc + 1;
          else
            error(rets[2]);
          end;
        else
          error(err);
        end;
      else
        error("Execution loader not found in current environment");
      end;
    else pc = pc + 1 end;
  end;
end;
return function(...) return v1421(1, {}, ...) end;
